title: Megaflo Repairs London | No Hot Water, Leaks & Discharge
description: Discuss megaflo repairs in london. Diagnosis-led support, clear scope and postcode-based availability. Call 020 7205 4433.
answer: Megaflo repair starts by distinguishing stored-water faults from the connected boiler, immersion or outlet that may cause the symptom.

sections.heading: What the service addresses
paragraphs: A cylinder can contain usable hot water while a single mixer shower remains cold. Equally, an indirect cylinder may be sound while a connected heating control fails to deliver heat to its coil. The investigation needs to separate the appliance from the supply and connected controls.

sections.heading: Planning the visit
paragraphs: For discharge faults, note whether water passes only during heating or continues when heating is off. Do not touch the water, hold relief valves open or block the pipe. The model and symptom history guide the safe investigation, not an assumption that every drip needs the same replacement.

sections.heading: Clear scope and practical next steps
paragraphs: Repairs should use components suitable for the exact model. Cylinder age, parts support, previous work and access all affect the practical decision. Ask for an explanation of what has failed and why the proposed work addresses the cause.

sections.heading: Arrange an enquiry
paragraphs: Contact 020 7205 4433 with your postcode, equipment make and model, symptoms and access details. The enquiry is used to establish the appropriate work and appointment availability. Costs and scope are discussed before agreed work.

faqs.question: Can a boiler fault cause cold water from a Megaflo tap?
faqs.answer: Yes, on an indirect system. The boiler or its controls may fail to heat the cylinder even when water still flows.
